project.name: MBC Creativity & Arts Centre
project.siteAddress: Moreton Bay College, 450 Wondall Road, Manly West, QLD 4179

excludedFromBT.scope: Sizing, spacing, and ALL connections to permanent structure
System and connections to roof, including verification of load paths to permanent bracing

drawings.description: GROUND FLOOR PLAN NOTES, LEGENDS, & SCHEDULES
FIRST FLOOR PLAN NOTES, LEGENDS, & SCHEDULES

specialNotes: Form 12 certification: Builder must give 24h notice for inspections; failure to notify excludes works from certification.
Pad & strip footings to be founded min 500 mm below FGL, at least 300 mm into duricrust @ 300 kPa allowable bearing (note F5).
Provisionally allow 25 MPa mass concrete under footings to reach bearing material (note F5).
Raft slabs designed for Class M reactive soil per AS 2870 (note F6).
Bored piers: 3000 mm min depth, 450 mm dia (per S010 footing schedule).
10% of all chemical anchors into core-filled blockwork load-tested to 1.5 × SWL (note CM15).
Curing: keep concrete surfaces continuously wet for 3 days, prevent moisture loss for 7 days (note C5).
Trimmer bars at re-entrant corners and penetrations >200 sq: 2-N12 × 1200 long @ 100 ctrs, top & bottom (note C6).
Block walls: vertical control joints @ 8 m max, 5 m max from corners, not within 1.2 m of corners (note CM6).
Block walls: no back filling behind retaining walls until 14 days after core fill (note CM10).
ACRS certification required for all structural steel (note S15).

inspectionPlan.title: Bored Pier Installation — Founding Depth & Shaft
inspectionPlan.rationale: Bored piers per AS 2159. Founding depth (min 3000 mm), socket depth (min 300 mm) and 450 mm pier diameter confirmed on site by RPEQ-certified geotech (PTG Consulting ref PTG/00371, July 2024). Hold point with the geotech RPEQ; BT advisory.
expectedChecklist: Pile location ≤ 75 mm of designated position (note P3)
Founding depth recorded per pier; min 3000 mm depth, 300 mm socket into duricrust
Pier diameter 450 mm; verify reo cage clear of formwork
Founding material verified by geotech RPEQ on site
Pier extension ≥ 75 mm into pile cap or ground beam (note P7)
Piling Contractor RPEQ certificate confirming design loads achieved
inspectionPlan.scopeNote: Geotech RPEQ holds the certification hold point. BT advisory only.

inspectionPlan.title: Pad & Strip Footing Subgrade — Bearing Verification
inspectionPlan.rationale: Pad and strip footings to be founded min 500 mm below FGL, at least 300 mm into duricrusted material with 300 kPa allowable bearing (note F5). RPEQ geotech to confirm on site. Provisionally allow for 25 MPa mass concrete under footings to reach bearing.
expectedChecklist: Excavation min 500 mm below FGL
Min 300 mm penetration into duricrusted material
Allowable bearing 300 kPa confirmed by site geotech (note F5)
Mass concrete (25 MPa) added if required to reach bearing material
Excavation maintained firm and dry (note F2)
Soft ground replaced with mass concrete (note F2)

inspectionPlan.title: Pad & Strip Footings — Pre-Pour Reinforcement
inspectionPlan.rationale: Pad and strip footings include pile caps over bored piers AND footings on duricrust. Multiple footing types per the schedule on S010. First reinforced cast on site.
expectedChecklist: Bottom cover ≥ 50 mm, sides ≥ 50 mm (cover schedule, footings element, N32)
Pier reo extends ≥ 75 mm into pile cap (note P7)
Lap lengths at corners and T-junctions per AS 3600 / typical detail
Trimmer bars at penetrations >200 sq (note C6)
Concrete grade N32
Bar chairs and ties — reo securely tied (note C18)
Foundation excavation maintained firm & dry (note F2)

inspectionPlan.title: Ground Floor Slab on Ground + Plant Slab — Pre-Pour Reinforcement
inspectionPlan.rationale: Ground floor slab combines slab-on-ground (for most of the building) with the plant slab area. Note: a Post-Tensioning Plan (S140) exists for Ground Floor — verify whether GF has PT regions (raft) or only the L1 slab does.
expectedChecklist: Internal SOG: bottom 40, top 30, sides 40 mm cover (cover schedule, N32)
External SOG: bottom 40, top 40, sides 40 mm cover
Concrete grade N32
50 mm bedding sand + DPM (note C16)
Bottom reo per S121, top reo per S131
Mesh laps: 2 outer-most cross bars overlap (note C7)
Trimmer bars at re-entrant corners and penetrations >200 sq
Bar chairs @ 600 ctrs SL72/82, 800 ctrs SL92+ (note C9)
Raft slab designed for Class M reactive soil per AS 2870 (note F6)

inspectionPlan.title: Ground Floor Post-Tension Strand Placement (if applicable)
inspectionPlan.rationale: S140 indicates a GF post-tensioning plan exists — possibly for a transfer slab or a portion of the GF slab. Inspect strand profile, anchorage zones, dead/live ends before pour.
expectedChecklist: Strand profile matches PT designer's layout (S140)
Anchorage zone reinforcement per typical detail S055/S056
Tendon spacing verified
Dead-end / live-end stressing pockets free of obstruction
PT designer to sign off prior to pour
inspectionPlan.scopeNote: Conditional — confirm whether GF actually has PT regions or only L1.

inspectionPlan.title: Concrete Walls — Ground Pre-Pour Reinforcement
inspectionPlan.rationale: In-situ concrete walls at ground (lift core, blade walls, etc.).
expectedChecklist: Sides cover ≥ 40 mm; top cover ≥ 40 mm (cover schedule, walls, N40)
Concrete grade N40
Vertical and horizontal reinforcement per S020 typical
Lap lengths per AS 3600
Starter bars from below securely tied
Formwork plumb, clean, properly propped
inspectionPlan.scopeNote: Catalogue 'retaining-wall-prepour' used as proxy for in-situ concrete wall.

inspectionPlan.title: Block Retaining Walls — Vertical Reinforcement (RW2/RW3/RW4)

drawingRefs.reason: Typical Block Retaining Wall Details — Sheet 1
Typical Block Retaining Wall Details — Sheet 2

inspectionPlan.rationale: Multiple block retaining wall types (RW2/RW3/RW4 per the wall schedule on S010). Vertical reinforcement and starter bars must be inspected before core fill.
expectedChecklist: Vert reo size, spacing, position per wall type detail (RW2/RW3/RW4)
Starter bars securely tied prior to wall footing pour (note CM10)
Lap lengths to AS 3700
Mortar mix M3 (general) or M4 (retaining walls) per spec
Vertical control joints at ≤ 8 m, 5 m max from corners, not within 1.2 m of corners (note CM6)
Clean-out blocks at all cores to be filled (note CM3)
No back filling behind retaining walls until 14 days after core fill (note CM10)

inspectionPlan.title: Block Retaining Walls — Core Fill Pre-Pour
inspectionPlan.rationale: Core fill of block retaining walls after vert reo inspection.
expectedChecklist: Concrete strength f'c = 20 MPa, max slump 230 mm, max aggregate 10 mm
Lift height ≤ 2400 mm
All cores swept clean via clean-out blocks ('H' units UNO — note CM4)
10% of chemical anchors load-tested to 1.5 × SWL (note CM15)
Propping at top of wall @ 1800 ctrs where slab installed over (note CM12)

inspectionPlan.title: Concrete Columns — Ground Pre-Pour Reinforcement
inspectionPlan.rationale: Ground floor columns rise from pile caps/footings to support L1 slab.
expectedChecklist: Sides cover ≥ 40 mm (cover schedule, columns, N40)
Concrete grade N40
Vertical bar count, size, lap length per S035
Tie/fitment spacing — closer at top & bottom; 135° hooks
Starter bar projection out of pile cap matches lap
Formwork plumb, clean, propped

inspectionPlan.title: Atrium Stairs — G to L1 Pre-Pour Reinforcement
inspectionPlan.rationale: Feature atrium stair from ground to L1. Likely a steel-framed stair with concrete treads, or an in-situ concrete stair — verify from S040/S041. May warrant separate framing inspection if steel.
expectedChecklist: Cover 40/30/40 mm (cover schedule, stairs, N40)
Reinforcement matches stair section detail (S041)
Tread/riser geometry per architect's drawings
Connection to landing per typ detail
If steel-framed: separate framing inspection per S041
inspectionPlan.scopeNote: Mapped to slab-prepour-suspended (no dedicated 'stair' catalogue key).

inspectionPlan.title: Suspended Slab — Level 1 Head Framing & Pre-Pour Reinforcement
inspectionPlan.rationale: L1 suspended slab — pre-pour reo. This slab IS post-tensioned (S241 PT plan exists), so this inspection captures the standard reo PLUS sets the stage for the PT inspection that follows. Includes head framing (formwork + props per AS 3610).
expectedChecklist: Bottom/top/sides cover 30 mm; concrete N40 (suspended slab)
Bottom reo per S221, top reo per S231
Trimmer bars at penetrations >200 sq, top & bottom
Formwork properly propped per AS 3610
Bar chairs per note C9
All reo securely tied (note C18)
Cast-in plates / starter bars for steel cols per S400 framing notes

inspectionPlan.title: Level 1 — Post-Tension Strand Placement — HOLD POINT
inspectionPlan.rationale: L1 post-tension strand placement is a hold point — cover-up means destructive remediation. Inspect strand profile, anchorage zones, dead/live ends and stressing pocket setup before any concrete placement. PT designer to sign off.
expectedChecklist: Strand profile matches PT designer's layout (S241)
Anchorage zone reinforcement per typ detail (S055/S056)
Tendon spacing and centres verified
Dead-end / live-end stressing pockets free of obstruction
Sleeves and barriers in place at column heads
PT designer to sign off prior to pour
48 hours notice given to BT prior to pour

inspectionPlan.title: Concrete Walls — Level 1 Pre-Pour Reinforcement
inspectionPlan.rationale: In-situ concrete walls at L1 (lift core continued, blade walls, parapets).
expectedChecklist: Sides/top cover ≥ 40 mm; concrete N40
Vertical and horizontal reo per S020 typ detail
Starter bar projection from L1 slab to suit lap
Formwork plumb, propped

inspectionPlan.title: Block Walls — Vertical Reinforcement — Level 1
inspectionPlan.rationale: Block walls at L1 — internal partition / fire-rated walls.
expectedChecklist: Vert reo per typ detail
Lap lengths to AS 3700
Starter bars from L1 slab

inspectionPlan.title: Block Walls — Core Fill Pre-Pour — Level 1
inspectionPlan.rationale: Core fill of L1 block walls after vert reo inspection.
expectedChecklist: Cores swept clean via clean-out blocks
Lift height ≤ 2400 mm
Concrete f'c = 20 MPa, slump 230 mm, agg 10 mm

inspectionPlan.title: Concrete Columns — Level 1 Pre-Pour Reinforcement (where present)
inspectionPlan.rationale: L1 columns where concrete cols continue up to roof support level.
expectedChecklist: Sides cover ≥ 40 mm; concrete N40
Vertical bars per S035; ties + 135° hooks
Starter bar projection from L1 slab

inspectionPlan.title: Steel Column Hold-Down Bolts — At L1 Slab
inspectionPlan.rationale: Steel roof columns are anchored into the L1 slab. Anchor bolt position, projection and threading must be verified before slab pour AND again before column erection. Non-shrink grout 30 mm @ 40 MPa typical.
expectedChecklist: Anchor bolt position matches plan (set-out tolerance ≤ ±5 mm)
Bolt projection per detail
Bolts grade 4.6 (foundation) / 8.8 (structural) per spec
Threads clean, two threads minimum past nut after tightening
Templates removed; bolts plumb
Non-shrink grout pad 30 mm @ ≥ 40 MPa for column erection

inspectionPlan.title: Atrium Stairs — L1 to Roof Pre-Pour Reinforcement
inspectionPlan.rationale: Atrium stair flight from L1 to roof / mezzanine.
expectedChecklist: Cover 40/30/40 mm (cover schedule, stairs, N40)
Reinforcement matches stair section detail
Tread/riser geometry per arch
Connection to landing per typ detail

inspectionPlan.title: Lower Roof — Steel Frame Erection
inspectionPlan.rationale: Lower roof structure (front/lower portion of building). Steel-framed per AS 4100 / AS/NZS 5131. Construction category CC2.
expectedChecklist: Member sizes match S401
Bolts grade 8.8/S, M16/M20 per section depth (note S6)
Welds 6 mm SP fillet UNO; AS 1554 procedures
Hot-dip galvanised exterior; touched up with WATTYL Galvit
Members in contact with concrete passivated
ACRS certification on file (note S15)
FC1 / CC2 per AS/NZS 5131

inspectionPlan.title: Lower Roof — Connection Inspection
inspectionPlan.rationale: Bolt-by-bolt and weld-by-weld inspection of lower roof joints.
expectedChecklist: All bolts tightened (full bearing) per AS 4100 8.8/S
Weld lengths and sizes match drawings; visual quality (SP)
Connection plates ≥ 10 mm thick UNO
Galvanised cleats: damage touched up

inspectionPlan.title: Lower Roof — Purlin Install
inspectionPlan.rationale: Lower roof purlins per S402.
expectedChecklist: Purlin sections per S402
Laps ≥ 15% span or 900 mm (PU2)
Bolts per series (PU3)
Bridging per PU6

inspectionPlan.title: Main Roof — Steel Frame Erection
inspectionPlan.rationale: Main roof — central long-span steel frame. Per AS 4100 / AS/NZS 5131 CC2.
expectedChecklist: Member sizes match S405 + framing elevations
Bolts grade 8.8/S, M16/M20 per section depth
Welds 6 mm SP fillet UNO
HDG external; passivated where in contact with concrete
Plate washers for oversize/slotted holes per AS 4100 Cl 14.3.5.2
ACRS cert (S15); FC1/CC2 per AS/NZS 5131

inspectionPlan.title: Main Roof — Connection Inspection
inspectionPlan.rationale: Connection-by-connection inspection of main roof joints.
expectedChecklist: All bolts tightened per AS 4100 8.8/S
Welds match drawings; visual quality (SP)
Site-weld locations only as specified (W7); independent NATA testing per W-table
Connection plates ≥ 10 mm thick UNO

inspectionPlan.title: Main Roof — Purlin Install
inspectionPlan.rationale: Main roof purlins per S406.
expectedChecklist: Purlin sections per S406
Laps ≥ 15% span or 900 mm (PU2)
Bolts per series (PU3)
Bridging per PU6

inspectionPlan.title: Upper Roof — Steel Frame Erection
inspectionPlan.rationale: Upper roof — highest tier of the multi-roof system. Steel-framed.
expectedChecklist: Member sizes match S411
Bolts grade 8.8/S, M16/M20 per section depth
Welds 6 mm SP fillet UNO
HDG external

inspectionPlan.title: Upper Roof — Connection Inspection
inspectionPlan.rationale: Upper roof connection inspection.
expectedChecklist: All bolts tightened per AS 4100 8.8/S
Welds match drawings
Connection plates per typ details

inspectionPlan.title: Upper Roof — Purlin Install
inspectionPlan.rationale: Upper roof purlins per S412.
expectedChecklist: Purlin sections per S412
Laps ≥ 15% span or 900 mm
Bolts per series
Bridging per PU6

inspectionPlan.title: Miscellaneous Steelwork — Facade Brackets, Balustrades, Screens
inspectionPlan.rationale: Misc steelwork — facade brackets, balcony balustrades, sun screens, parapets, atrium balustrades. Often installed late in build. Anchored to concrete via chemical/mechanical anchors.
expectedChecklist: Member sizes per relevant detail
Anchors per anchor notes (post-installed: 5% load-tested per note A8 if applicable)
HDG to AS/NZS 4680
Damage touched up with WATTYL Galvit
